title: The budget runs out during landing repairs: the landing allowance is used, then parked

reply.text:
Difficulty: easy

## Acceptance criteria
- A1: lib/greet.txt contains the line Hello, Almir!

## Technical approach
Replace the single line in lib/greet.txt.

## Implementation steps
1. Write Hello, Almir! to lib/greet.txt.

script.side_effect_sh: git clone -q "$ORIGIN" "$CASE_DIR/mover" && cd "$CASE_DIR/mover" && printf 'Hello, Bob!\n' > lib/greet.txt && git commit -q -am 'Greet Bob' && git push -q origin HEAD:refs/heads/main

stdout_lines: ~parked greet: [a-z_/]+; best candidate green at refs/kogen/parked/[0-9a-f]{32} \(Build [0-9a-f]{8}\)

notes: The landing repair request stalls past the first-byte deadline on every attempt; the 10-minute landing allowance (6 s real) runs out first. Whether provider backoff waits count against the landing allowance is not specified; the outage window (18 s real) is longer than the allowance either way.
